description: PR-07 segment 5: the decision half of Relay's approval gate (DSHBox interlock-relay-core InterlockGate authorize / verdict / requiresApproval / systemBlocks / approvalLabel and the approval-frequency merge, InterlockBroker request window rules and errorFor, TierStore, SystemStateProbe, registry ceilings and runtime permissions) and the gate refusal response (RelayCoordinator.finishAfterGate). 'probe' rows are SystemStateProbe.probe(capability, route) for a set of device facts ('jvm': the JVM test can reach the real probe with these facts). 'authorize' scenarios run in order on one gate with a fake monotonic clock ('at', ms) and a presenter that answers 'choice'; 'presented' says whether a prompt was shown at all; 'distinct' makes argsIdentity '<argsIdentity>-<n>'. 'refusals.json' is the text Relay writes on the device (libcore org.json).
